On The 4 th Of December, 2025
 Criminal Appeal No. 1006 of 2018
 Brajlal @ Pinku
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Vivek Agrawal - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri S. Raghuwanshi - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/Stat
 Order

Counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has been convicted under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 03 years and fine of Rs.1000/-; R.I. for 05 years and fine of Rs.1000/-; and R.I. for 10 years and fine of Rs.3000/- with default stipulations vide judgment dated 25.01.2018 passed by the learned Third Additional Sessions Judge, Gadarwara District Narsinghpur in Sessions Trial No.48 of 2014.

entities.text: Third Additional Sessions Judge, Gadarwara District Narsinghpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the appellant has already undergone the entire jail sentence and has been released after completing the same.
Hence, the present appeal has rendered infructuous.

In this regard, a report dated 03.12.2025 received from the office of the Superintendent, Central Jail, Narsinghpur, indicates that the appellant/accused has been released after serving out the entire sentence awarded by the learned Trial Court.

Learned counsel for the State does not dispute the aforesaid factual NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:63380 2 CRA-1006-2018 position.
In view of the above, nothing survives for adjudication in this appeal.
Accordingly, the Criminal Appeal stands dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE DV Brajlal @ Pinku vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167223930/
